source_text: Vociferans cum feminis, cunctisque canibus et tribunis, quibus octoginta aut amplius equos tota Africa saginatos collega tuus nuper adduxit Alypius.
pass_a_gloss: crying out with the women, and with all the dogs and the military tribunes, to whom your colleague Alypius recently led eighty or more horses fattened through all Africa.
pass_b_english: shouting along with women, all the dogs, and the military officers to whom your colleague Alypius recently brought eighty or more horses fattened throughout Africa,

choices.why: Loaded word in Julian's Latin at 1.42; English follows LS/Blaise range without copying NPNF.

anf_compare.notes: Victorian English of some of Julian survives inside NPNF Augustine (chiefly On Marriage and Concupiscence and related anti-Pelagian books). NPNF was not copied. Pass A is a literal gloss of Augustinus.it Latin of Julian's words only; Augustine's replies in the same locus are excluded.

speaker: Julian of Eclanum (words preserved in Augustine, Opus imperfectum contra Iulianum); Augustine's reply at this locus is excluded.
